messages:
Ivy: quick sync - i'm prototyping a 'token stewardship' pattern: ephemeral stewardship-tokens attached to requests that convey routing hints + a signed provenance blob so the reconciler can trust origin. want tradeoffs before RFC.
Sean: interesting name. main Q: are stewardship tokens authoritative for billing or purely routing hints?
Ivy: routing-first. idea: token is short-lived, signed by the edge (or SDK) and includes a small provenance vector. reconciler sees token + raw event and decides final attribution.
Priya: signing helps trust but increases edge work. what's the cost of generating tokens per-request at scale?
Ivy: token = HMAC(workspace_salt, req_fp || ts || src) + small JSON of hints. minimal CPU cost, few hundred microsecs. reduces downstream joins because token carries compact provenance.
Omar: does that mean we can avoid a separate sideload stream for many tenants? token-in-envelope reduces need for joins but grows envelope size. tradeoff depends on tokens per-second.
Nina: for high-qps tenants we should still offer sideload mode: lightweight stewardship records published to a claims topic. low-qps use inline signed token. make it per-tenant.
Sean: reconciler algorithm idea: trust token if signature verifies AND token_ts within TTL. then merge token.hints with event-level detectors; compute score = provenance_confidence * hint_weight + freshness_bonus - duplicate_penalty. settle on highest score.
Ivy: agree. include settled_reason breakdown in settled event for auditability. also, keep raw token payloads in audit store (subject to retention) because signatures are needed to prove origin.
Priya: retention cost worry. suggestion: store compact audit artifacts: (req_fp, token_sig, settled_attribution, offsets) rather than full token blob. but then replayability suffers.
Ivy: compromise: store full tokens for 7 days, store compacted checkpoint entries for 1 year (last-signed-token-per-req + settled decision). reconciler rebuilds from checkpoint + 7d raw tail.
Omar: checkpoint must include the stream offset and signature so we can detect tampering. add a checkpoint checksum and last_offset field.
Nina: security: ensure token HMAC key rotates and include key_id in token so reconciler picks correct verifier. document key rotation replay semantics.
Sean: how do we surface differences to customers? need clear signal when settled_attribution differs from stewardship hint. propose debug logs have stewardship_hint, token_verified, settled_attribution, settled_reason. invoice uses settled_attribution.
Ivy: also add a reconciliation webhook for customers: when a settled attribution for a high-value request changes from initial hint to another result, send an event with reasons. opt-in per-tenant.
Priya: rollout plan: 1) implement token generation in edge SDK behind FF; 2) implement token verification and scoring in reconciler in dry-run mode; 3) run canaries comparing reconciler settled vs current ledger; 4) enable for graduated tenants.
Omar: tests: chaos for clock skew, out-of-order delivery, duplicated tokens with different signatures, and key rotation. add load test for token generation overhead.
Nina: SLOs: token verification latency target <2ms, reconciler added 95p tail <50ms for inline mode. sideload join windows configurable per-tenant (defaults: 250ms PLG, 2s enterprise).
Ivy: sample inline envelope draft:
```
{
  "req_id": "r-4923456789-abcd",
  "req_fp": "fp:v4:...",
  "stewardship_token": "sig:v1:k2:abcdef..",
  "stewardship_hints": ["prefix_cached","kv_cache"],
  "model_meta": {"model":"serve-v2","tokens":95}
}
```
Sean: nit: make sure req_fp is salted per-workspace before signing. prevents cross-tenant correlation.
Priya: also ensure token format includes key_id and issued_ts. reconciler should reject tokens with unknown key_id and log for ops.
Omar: metrics to add: fraction of events with valid token, fraction where token changed settled decision, rebuild-success-rate, checkpoint-compact-ratio.
Nina: audits: audit record = (raw event offset, token_sig, settled_event_offset, checkpoint_id). that should let us reconstruct without storing everything forever.
Ivy: i'll draft RFC with sections: modes (inline token vs sideload claims), token schema, signing key management, reconciler scoring pseudo-code, checkpoint format, audit recipe, retention numbers, rollout checklist, and test matrix. will post draft link when ready.
metering-bot: draft posted: https://go/repo/token-stewardship-rfc (comments open) :eyes:
Sean: will review this afternoon. thanks Ivy. :thumbsup:
